decisions.reason: The same source message already establishes better mixing quality and consistent foam in this Requirement; the bowl-capacity change requires no additional state change.
Selecting smaller bowls does not change the existing requirement for a removable or easily cleaned spout.
The existing compact-enclosure constraint remains valid and unchanged; the source decision specifies bowl capacity and does not replace any enclosure attribute.
The bowl selection may inform later BOM content, but it does not change the requirement to deliver a prototype bill of materials.
The smaller bowl is preferred partly for aesthetics, but the DJ turntable-inspired visual theme remains unchanged.
The source discusses bowl size and visual proportions but makes no color-scheme decision.
The source does not change the splash-control target or state that smaller bowls alter that requirement.
Choosing smaller bowls does not modify the established off-the-shelf electronic component strategy.
The bowl decision may be reflected in future drawings, but it does not change the requirement to provide a system layout.
The source does not alter the required smooth, controlled dispensing flow or its flow-rate constraints.
Bowl capacity does not change the requirement to provide a basic electrical wiring plan.
Accepting refills and preferring faster visual cycles does not modify the existing event-use reliability requirement.
